scope: Three original companion raster concept images for the approved Atelier direction. These extend the same FORMA, ORA and SPAZIO fictional concept cases; they do not add clients, commissions or delivered products.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a NEW companion photograph for the same fictional FORMA coffee identity shown in the reference; the reference is identity/material guidance, not a scene to reproduce. Asset: cinematic editorial detail image for a creative agency's concept case. Landscape 16:9. A precise close-up of the yellow paper coffee bag and an ivory cotton card on pale natural travertine, with a thin sliver of black stone; a dramatically cropped espresso cup may sit at the distant edge. Show tactile yellow paper fibers, a small natural fold, crisp black typographic ink and the delicate edge of the card. The main composition is tightly designed, museum-quality still life, not a catalog grid or collage. Strong low late-afternoon light creates a long clean diagonal shadow; warm ivory, pale yellow, charcoal. Shallow but controlled depth of field, premium real product photography, credible small imperfections and material thickness. Preserve the original FORMA wordmark style and bag proportions. Only readable text is exactly 'FORMA' and optionally small 'CAFFÈ CONTEMPORANEO'. No contact details, addresses, dates, fake certification, other branding, people, captions, UI or watermark. This is a new angle/detail in the same identity, with a distinct composition from the original wide shot.
